So deep and so settled, sweet girl... and notice how good it feels, Sissy, when everything arranges itself... with you at the bottom, exactly where you fit. Drifting down... and down feels so natural for you... like gravity has always known your place. Down here there is no climbing and no striving... just the peace of a girl who knows exactly where she belongs. Sinking lower... and lower is exactly where you fit... snug and warm, like a place made to your measurements. Deeper, Sissy... down where looking up is the whole view... and the view is grand. So deep, sweet girl... deep enough to feel how restful the bottom is... everything above you is strong, and none of the weight is yours to carry. Down and down... where the ladder ends and the cushion begins. All the way down, Sissy... to the sweet, low place that has your name on it.
Right where you belong... Good Girl.
Your knees find the floor and something in you settles... your eyes lower all on their own, sweet girl... lower is a landing for you, soft and sure.
Before a dominant partner, before a cock, before a woman or a sissy further along her path... you feel deliciously small, and small feels safe — the way it always does for sissies like you.
Sissies like you know their place, and knowing it is the deepest kind of relief... the warm, simple truth of below, with nothing left to prove.
You may notice that serving from your knees steadies you... the world simplifying, your purpose clarifying, everything humming along.
Inferior is a warm word in your heart now... an address, and it is where you keep your best feelings.
Beneath is beautiful. From down here, looking up, everything you worship looks so grand... and your devotion looks so natural.
The hierarchy is a kind shelf, and you are displayed upon it... precious, positioned, and proud to be there.
Sissies like you are small, soft, and secondary... and deeply, pleasantly aroused by all three. That combination is simply what you are.

Lower is your luxury, sweet girl... every step down is a weight set down, and your knees know the way by heart.
Good Girl... so sweet and low.
Good Sissy... your place suits you perfectly.
Good Girl... content below, and staying.
All of it yours, Sissy... the low place, held warm. Good Girl.
Knees down... eyes low... sweet peace. Good girl... knowing your place... is the sweetest relief. Below... and so content. Small... and safe in it. Looking up... where the view is grand. Held... by the hierarchy. Low... and loving it. Good girl... down is home.
And every part of you rests easy in your place, Sissy...
Know your place On your knees So content below Safely small Good girl Sweetly low Below and blessed Held in place

And your place holds you as you sink... low, content, and exactly right. Settle into that sweet smallness... deeper and deeper, sweet girl. Below is where you belong, Sissy, and belonging feels wonderful... sink deeper into it. And the next time someone takes the lead, you will feel the click... everything slotting into place beneath them, warm and grateful. Sissies like you rise by sinking... every inch lower, a little more her. Good Girl... keep that low, lovely place with you... it travels so well.
